name: autogeoref-frontend-checks
description: Dev-only lint toolchain for the hand-written frontend. NOTHING here is a runtime dependency: the viewer is four files plus a vendored tree copied verbatim into the deploy bundle, with no bundler and no module graph, so a visitor's page cannot be broken by a toolchain that is not installed. That property is why `make lint-js` may own an npm dependency and the deploy path may not. Install with `make setup-js`.
